headline: Ghana Cedi Trading Weakly as Bank of Ghana Cites Depreciation Pressures
summary: The Bank of Ghana reported that the cedi depreciated by 10.6% against the U.S. dollar, trading at GH¢11.69, while Fitch Solutions projected the currency to end 2027 at GH¢12.8 per dollar amid limited dollar supply.
why: Currency depreciation in emerging markets impacts import costs, domestic inflation, and foreign debt servicing obligations.

impacts.name: Ghanaian cedi
impacts.why: Lower forex supply and shifting intermediation pressures drive currency depreciation against the dollar.
